title: Jubilant Irish Potato Stew
description: A funky, tender, festive Irish stew featuring vanilla pod for subtle sweetness and a creamy finish, perfect for a vegetarian holiday meal.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Add sliced carrots and diced potatoes to the pot and stir to coat with oil for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth, add the split vanilla pod, thyme sprigs, salt, and pepper; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Remove the vanilla pod and thyme sprigs, then stir in the frozen peas and allow to heat through for 5 minutes.
Whisk the vegan yogurt with a tablespoon of hot stew liquid to temper it, preventing curdling.
Fold the tempered yogurt into the pot and stir gently until creamy and heated.
Serve hot garnished with fresh thyme leaves.
